summary: Backend-only verification of draft-form public submission gating bug fix + new admin-only preview endpoint. All 6 targeted assertions pass and full 48-test regression suite (Phase 11 admin guard + D2D auth alias + E2E journeys) still 48/48. Total 54/54.
critical_code_review_comments: marketing.py: public GET uses 'form.get(status) == draft' vs public POST uses 'form.get(status) != published'. Semantics differ if a third status ever appears (e.g. archived): GET would expose it, POST would 404. Not a bug today but flagged for consistency.
Preview endpoint correctly excludes notify_emails and requires admin; tech role receives 403 as expected.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEST_pool_audit_{draft|published} form via POST /api/forms and cleans it up with DELETE /api/forms/{id}; conftest teardown also purges forms with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_public_form_draft_gate.py is the canonical regression for this fix. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (must be exported before pytest run since backend .env doesn't set it). Draft slug 'poolscape-audit' is reused across tests; cleanup runs in finally blocks so parallel runs are safe.
rca of the issue: Prior code: POST /api/public/forms/{slug}/submit only looked up form by slug/id without checking status, so submissions succeeded for draft forms while GET returned 404 (inconsistent surface). Fix in marketing.py L73-78 gates on form.status == 'published'; new GET /api/forms/{fid}/preview (L94-102) provides admin builder access to drafts without changing publish state.
